title: WALTEUR Agent Tool Contract
description: Per-tool contract for an agent-callable tool. Every tool the agent can invoke MUST declare a typed input/output, its side-effect class, idempotency, an error taxonomy, and whether a human/oversight gate is required. CONSTRAINT: write_irreversible and external_money side effects REQUIRE oversight_gate=true.

name.description: Stable, unique tool identifier the agent calls.

input.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input arguments.

output.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's successful output.

side_effect_class.description: Blast radius of invoking this tool. read = no external mutation; write_undoable = mutation with a known compensating action; write_irreversible = mutation with no rollback; external_money = moves money or incurs unrecoverable cost.

idempotent.description: True iff calling the tool more than once with identical input has the same effect as calling it once.

error_taxonomy.description: Enumerated, named failure modes the caller must be able to handle.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may safely retry on this error.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of when this error fires.

oversight_gate.description: True iff a human (or higher-authority gate) must approve before the tool executes.
